trialOrder: iteration 1..3, condition A/B/D, arm off/on on odd, on/off on even; fresh context/page per trial
observationPolicy: Observer ON installs round12 event+MutationObserver probe before navigation. OFF never installs it. Both arms receive identical Playwright tracing, snapshot calls, user input, and screenshots. OFF is not a measurement-free or browser-events-free condition.

decisions.observerEffect: Pair comparisons within the same condition/iteration and engine/OS; mismatched target DOM/geometry/scroll -> UNCONFIRMED; do not infer no events from OFF logs.
decisions.transition: Compare acquisition -> afterSpace -> afterEscape without snapshots/screenshots/rAF inserted between input and states except common completion wait; each stage observed identically in ON/OFF.
decisions.rootCause: UNKNOWN until independent review; no SDK/browser-internal causal claim.

exclusions: No other widths or reduced motion
No raw evidence upload before privacy review
No merge or Stage 3 HOLD release
